title: Coast Guard rescues man in water
description: A 24-foot Special Purpose Craft-Shallow Water boatcrew from Coast Guard Station Grand Isle, Louisiana, rescued a man in the water whose vessel caught fire approximately 25 miles west of Grand Isle August 23, 2017. The boatcrew transported the man to Leeville Boat Launch in stable condition. (U.S. Coast Guard photo courtesy of Coast Guard Station Grand Isle/Released)
